                content: contextMsg ? `针对最新对话，请进行回应。` : '请根据当前聊天氛围或游戏处境说一句话。'
            }
        ];

        try {
            const res = await Nuojiji.ai({ messages, maxTokens: 50000 });
            if (res && res.success && res.text) {
                const clean = sanitizeAIText(res.text);
                if (clean) {
                    chatMsg(aiCallName, clean, ai.avatar, ai.appAvatar);
                    // 把 AI 的回复也存进历史纪录，方便下一轮对话形成连续性
                    G.chatHistory.push({ role: 'assistant', content: `${aiCallName}：${clean}` });
                }
            }
        } catch (e) {
            chatMsg('系统', `${aiCallName} 连线中断`, '⚠️', null);
        }
        if (aiPlayers.indexOf(ai) < aiPlayers.length - 1) await sleep(400);
    }

    if (btn) { btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = '💬 回复'; }
}



function sendChat(){
    const input=document.getElementById('chat-input');
    const msg=input.value.trim();if(!msg)return;
    const human=G.players.find(p=>p.isHuman);
    chatMsg(human?.name||'我',msg,human?.avatar||'😊',null);
    G.chatHistory.push({role:'user',content:`${human?.name}说：${msg}`});
    input.value='';
    // 不自动触发AI，由用户点「回复」按钮
}

// ==================== 道具使用 ====================
function useItem(key,idx){
    const human=G.players.find(p=>p.isHuman);
    if(!human?.items||human.items[idx]!==key)return;
    // 先关闭道具弹窗
    document.getElementById('items-overlay').classList.remove('active');
    G.pendingItemUse={key,idx};

    if(key==='stop'||key==='steal'){
        showTargetSelect();
    } else if(key==='shield'){
        human.shieldActive=true;human.items.splice(idx,1);
        log(`${human.name}使用了🛡️护盾卡！`,'imp');
        queuePopup('🛡️','护盾激活！',`${human.name}的下次租金/税收将被免除。`);
        G.pendingItemUse=null;updateActionBar();
    } else if(key==='double'){
        human.doubleNextRoll=true;human.items.splice(idx,1);
        log(`${human.name}使用了✨双倍卡！`,'imp');
        queuePopup('✨','双倍！',`${human.name}下次掷骰步数×2！`);
        G.pendingItemUse=null;updateActionBar();
    } else if(key==='free_park'){
        human.freeParking=true;human.items.splice(idx,1);
        log(`${human.name}使用了🅿️免费停车卡！`,'imp');
        G.pendingItemUse=null;updateActionBar();
    }
}

function showTargetSelect(){
    const human=G.players.find(p=>p.isHuman);
    const targets=G.players.filter(p=>p!==human&&!p.bankrupt);
    document.getElementById('target-list').innerHTML=targets.map(p=>`
        <div class="target-opt" onclick="confirmTarget('${p.name.replace(/'/g,"\\'")}')">
            <div class="to-av">
                ${p.appAvatar
                    ?`<img src="${p.appAvatar}" onerror="this.outerHTML='<span style=font-size:16px>${p.avatar}</span>'">`
                    :`<span style="font-size:16px">${p.avatar}</span>`}
            </div>
            <span>${p.name}</span>
            <span style="margin-left:auto;font-size:10px;color:var(--text-dim)">¥${p.money.toLocaleString()}</span>
        </div>
    `).join('');
    document.getElementById('target-overlay').classList.add('active');
}

function confirmTarget(targetName){
    const human=G.players.find(p=>p.isHuman);
    const target=G.players.find(p=>p.name===targetName);
    if(!human||!target||!G.pendingItemUse)return;
    const{key,idx}=G.pendingItemUse;
    if(key==='stop'){
        target.skipNextTurn=true;
        log(`${human.name}对${target.name}用了🛑停止卡！`,'imp');
        queuePopup('🛑','停止卡！',`${target.name} 下回合将被跳过！`);
    } else if(key==='steal'){
        const s=Math.min(500,target.money);
        target.money-=s;human.money+=s;
        log(`${human.name}偷了${target.name} ¥${s}`,'imp');
        queuePopup('🦹','偷窃成功！',`从 ${target.name} 偷走了 ¥${s}！`);
    }
    human.items.splice(idx,1);
    G.pendingItemUse=null;
    closeTargetSelect();
    updateAllUI();
}

function closeTargetSelect(e){
    if(e&&e.target!==document.getElementById('target-overlay'))return;
    document.getElementById('target-overlay').classList.remove('active');
    G.pendingItemUse=null;
}

// ==================== 回合处理 ====================
async function processTurn(){
    if(!G.gameRunning)return;
    const cp=curPlayer();
    if(!cp||cp.bankrupt){advanceTurn();return;}
    if(cp.skipNextTurn){
        cp.skipNextTurn=false;
        log(`${cp.name} 被停止卡跳过本回合`,'bad');
        queuePopup('🛑','跳过',`${cp.name} 被停止卡影响，跳过本回合。`,2000);
        await sleep(2300);advanceTurn();return;
    }
    if(cp.inJail>0){
        cp.inJail--;
        log(`${cp.name} 在监狱(还需${cp.inJail}回合)`,'bad');
        queuePopup('🔒','监狱中',`${cp.name} 还在监狱，等待${cp.inJail}回合。`,2000);
        await sleep(2300);advanceTurn();return;
    }
    updateAllUI();
    if(cp.isHuman){
        G.actionTaken=false;
        updateActionBar();
        document.getElementById('btn-buy-land').disabled=true;
        document.getElementById('btn-build').disabled=true;
        chatMsg('系统',`👑 轮到你了，${cp.name}！请掷骰子。`,'🎩',null);
    } else {
        await sleep(400);
        await aiTurn(cp);
        advanceTurn();
    }
}

async function playerRollDice(){
    const cp=curPlayer();
    if(!cp?.isHuman||G.actionTaken)return;
    document.getElementById('btn-roll').disabled=true;
    const d1=rnd(1,6),d2=rnd(1,6);
    let steps=cp.doubleNextRoll?(d1+d2)*2:d1+d2;
    if(cp.doubleNextRoll)cp.doubleNextRoll=false;
    await showDice(cp.name,d1,d2,true);
    document.getElementById('dice-display').textContent=`🎲${d1}+${d2}=${steps}`;
    log(`${cp.name} 掷出 ${d1}+${d2}=${steps}`);
    const from=cp.position;
    await moveAnimate(cp,from,steps);
    if(from+steps>=40){
        cp.money+=2000;
        log(`${cp.name} 经过起点 +¥2000！`,'imp');
        queuePopup('🚩','经过起点！',`${cp.name} 经过起点，领取 ¥2000！`);
    }
    G.actionTaken=true;
    renderBoard();updateAllUI();
    await handleTile(cp,true);
    renderBoard();updateAllUI();
    checkBuyBuild();
    document.getElementById('btn-end').disabled=false;
}

function playerBuyLand(){
    const cp=curPlayer();
    const t=BOARD[cp.position];
    if(!cp?.isHuman||!t||t.owner||cp.money<t.price)return;
    cp.money-=t.price;t.owner=cp.name;t.ownerIdx=G.players.indexOf(cp);
    cp.properties.push({tileId:t.id,name:t.name});
    log(`${cp.name} 购买了 ${t.name}！`,'imp');
    queuePopup('🏗','购地成功！',`${cp.name} 花 ¥${t.price.toLocaleString()} 购入【${t.name}】！`);
    checkBuyBuild();renderBoard();updateAllUI();
}

function playerBuildHouse(){
    const cp=curPlayer();if(!cp?.isHuman)return;
    const buildable=cp.properties.filter(pr=>{
        const t=BOARD[pr.tileId];
        return t&&t.type==='property'&&(t.houses||0)<4&&cp.money>=(t.houseCost||500);
    });
    if(!buildable.length)return;
    const pr=buildable[0];const t=BOARD[pr.tileId];
    cp.money-=t.houseCost;t.houses=(t.houses||0)+1;
    log(`${cp.name} 在${t.name}建了第${t.houses}栋房！`,'imp');
    queuePopup('🏠','建房！',`${cp.name} 在【${t.name}】建了第${t.houses}栋房，花 ¥${t.houseCost.toLocaleString()}。`);
    checkBuyBuild();renderBoard();updateAllUI();
}

function playerEndTurn(){
    if(!G.actionTaken)return;
    const cp=curPlayer();
    if(cp.shieldActive)cp.shieldActive=false;
    document.getElementById('btn-buy-land').disabled=true;
    document.getElementById('btn-build').disabled=true;
    document.getElementById('btn-end').disabled=true;
    advanceTurn();
}

async function aiTurn(ai){
    const d1=rnd(1,6),d2=rnd(1,6);
    let steps=ai.doubleNextRoll?(d1+d2)*2:d1+d2;
    if(ai.doubleNextRoll)ai.doubleNextRoll=false;
    log(`${ai.name} 掷出 ${d1}+${d2}=${steps}`);
    await showDice(ai.name,d1,d2,false);
    const from=ai.position;
    await moveAnimate(ai,from,steps);
    if(from+steps>=40){
        ai.money+=2000;
        log(`${ai.name} 经过起点 +¥2000`,'imp');
        queuePopup('🚩','经过起点',`${ai.name} 经过起点获得 ¥2000。`,2000);
        await sleep(2200);
    }
    await handleTile(ai,false);
    await aiDecideBuild(ai);
    await aiUseItem(ai);
    if(ai.shieldActive)ai.shieldActive=false;
    renderBoard();updateAllUI();
}

async function handleTile(player,isHuman){
    const t=BOARD[player.position];
    switch(t.type){
        case 'property':case 'station':case 'utility':
            if(!t.owner){
                if(!isHuman&&aiDecideBuy(player,t)&&player.money>=t.price){
                    player.money-=t.price;t.owner=player.name;t.ownerIdx=G.players.indexOf(player);
                    player.properties.push({tileId:t.id,name:t.name});
                    log(`${player.name} 购买了${t.name}`,'imp');
                    queuePopup('🏗','购地',`${player.name} 购入【${t.name}】！`,2000);
                    await sleep(2200);
                }
            } else if(t.owner!==player.name){
                let rent=calcRent(t);
                if(player.freeParking){player.freeParking=false;rent=0;log(`${player.name}用停车卡免租金`);}
                if(player.shieldActive){player.shieldActive=false;rent=0;log(`${player.name}盾牌免租金`);}
                if(rent>0){
                    player.money-=rent;
                    const owner=G.players.find(p=>p.name===t.owner);
                    if(owner)owner.money+=rent;
                    log(`${player.name} 付租金¥${rent}给${t.owner}`,'bad');
                    queuePopup('💸','缴租金',`${player.name} 向 ${t.owner} 缴纳租金 ¥${rent}！`);
                    await sleep(300);
                }
            }
            break;
        case 'tax':{
            let tax=t.taxAmount||800;
            if(player.shieldActive){player.shieldActive=false;tax=0;}
            if(tax>0){
                player.money-=tax;
                log(`${player.name} 缴税¥${tax}`,'bad');
                queuePopup('💰','缴税',`${player.name} 缴纳税款 ¥${tax}！`);
                await sleep(300);
            }
            break;
        }
        case 'chance':{
            const card=CHANCE_CARDS[rnd(0,CHANCE_CARDS.length-1)];
            const result=card.fn(player,G);
            log(`机会卡：${card.name}→${result}`,'imp');
            queuePopup(card.emoji,card.intoItems?`抽到：${card.name}`:`机会：${card.name}`,
                `${player.name} 抽到【${card.name}】！\n结果：${result}${card.intoItems?'\n🎒 已放入道具栏！':''}`);
            await sleep(300);
            break;
        }
        case 'fate':{
            const card=FATE_CARDS[rnd(0,FATE_CARDS.length-1)];
            const result=card.fn(player,G);
            log(`命运卡：${card.name}→${result}`,'bad');
            queuePopup(card.emoji,`命运：${card.name}`,`${player.name} 抽到【${card.name}】！\n结果：${result}`);
            await sleep(300);
            break;
        }
        case 'go-to-jail':
            player.position=10;player.inJail=2;
            log(`${player.name} 进监狱！`,'bad');
            queuePopup('🚔','进监狱！',`${player.name} 被送进监狱，等待2回合！`);
            renderBoard();await sleep(300);
            break;
    }
    if(player.money<0&&!player.bankrupt){
        player.bankrupt=true;
        player.properties.forEach(pr=>{const t=BOARD[pr.tileId];if(t){t.owner=null;t.ownerIdx=-1;t.houses=0;}});
        player.properties=[];player.money=0;
        log(`💀 ${player.name} 破产出局！`,'bad');
        queuePopup('💀','破产！',`${player.name} 资金耗尽，宣告破产出局！`);
    }
}

function calcRent(t){
    if(t.type==='station'){
        const o=G.players.find(p=>p.name===t.owner);
        const cnt=o?.properties.filter(pr=>BOARD[pr.tileId]?.type==='station').length||1;
        return t.rent[Math.min(cnt-1,3)];
    }
    if(t.type==='utility')return t.rent[rnd(0,1)];
    return t.rent[Math.min(t.houses||0,4)];
}

function aiDecideBuy(player,tile){
    if(!tile)return false;
    const r={aggressive:1.3,conservative:3.0,lucky:1.5,tricky:1.8,bold:1.4}[player.strategy]||2.0;
    return player.money>=tile.price*r;
}

async function aiDecideBuild(ai){
    const b=ai.properties.filter(pr=>{const t=BOARD[pr.tileId];return t&&t.type==='property'&&(t.houses||0)<4&&ai.money>=(t.houseCost||500);});
    if(!b.length)return;
    if(ai.strategy==='aggressive'||ai.strategy==='bold'||ai.money>8000){
        const pr=b[rnd(0,b.length-1)];const t=BOARD[pr.tileId];
        ai.money-=t.houseCost;t.houses=(t.houses||0)+1;
        log(`${ai.name} 在${t.name}建了第${t.houses}栋房`,'imp');
        queuePopup('🏠','建房',`${ai.name} 在【${t.name}】建了第${t.houses}栋房！`,2000);
        await sleep(2200);
    }
}

async function aiUseItem(ai){
    if(!ai.items?.length||Math.random()>0.25)return;
    const usable=ai.items.filter(k=>k==='stop'||k==='steal');
    if(!usable.length)return;
    const key=usable[rnd(0,usable.length-1)];
    const targets=G.players.filter(p=>p!==ai&&!p.bankrupt);
    if(!targets.length)return;
    const target=targets[rnd(0,targets.length-1)];
    const idx=ai.items.indexOf(key);
    if(key==='stop'){
        target.skipNextTurn=true;
        log(`${ai.name}对${target.name}用了🛑`,'imp');
        queuePopup('🛑','道具',`${ai.name} 对 ${target.name} 使用停止卡！`,2000);
    } else {
        const s=Math.min(500,target.money);
        target.money-=s;ai.money+=s;
        log(`${ai.name}偷${target.name}¥${s}`,'imp');
        queuePopup('🦹','被偷',`${ai.name} 偷走了 ${target.name} 的 ¥${s}！`,2000);
    }
    ai.items.splice(idx,1);
    await sleep(2200);
}

function advanceTurn(){
    if(G.players.filter(p=>!p.bankrupt).length<=1){endGame();return;}
    do{
        G.currentPlayerIdx=(G.currentPlayerIdx+1)%G.players.length;
        if(G.currentPlayerIdx===0){
            G.currentRound++;
            if(G.currentRound>1&&(G.currentRound-1)%G.settleFreq===0&&G.currentRound<=G.totalRounds){
                showRank();return;
            }
            if(G.currentRound>G.totalRounds){endGame();return;}
        }
    }while(G.players[G.currentPlayerIdx]?.bankrupt);
    G.actionTaken=false;
    document.getElementById('dice-display').textContent='';
    updateAllUI();renderBoard();
    setTimeout(()=>processTurn(),400);
}

function showRank(){
    const active=G.players.filter(p=>!p.bankrupt).sort((a,b)=>getTotalAssets(b)-getTotalAssets(a));
    const rk=['🥇','🥈','🥉','#4'];
    document.getElementById('rank-title').textContent=`📊 第${G.currentRound-1}回合排名`;
    document.getElementById('rank-list').innerHTML=
        active.map((p,i)=>`<div class="rank-row">
            <div class="rpos">${rk[i]}</div>
            <div class="rinfo"><div>${p.name}${p.isHuman?' 👑':''}</div><div class="rmoney">💰¥${p.money.toLocaleString()} 总¥${getTotalAssets(p).toLocaleString()}</div></div>
        </div>`).join('')+
        G.players.filter(p=>p.bankrupt).map(p=>`<div class="rank-row" style="opacity:0.4"><div class="rpos">💀</div><div class="rinfo">${p.name} 破产</div></div>`).join('');
    document.getElementById('rank-overlay').classList.add('active');
}

function closeRankModal(){
    document.getElementById('rank-overlay').classList.remove('active');
    if(G.currentRound>G.totalRounds){endGame();return;}
    updateAllUI();renderBoard();
    setTimeout(()=>processTurn(),400);
}

function endGame(){
    G.gameRunning=false;
    const ranked=G.players.sort((a,b)=>getTotalAssets(b)-getTotalAssets(a));
    const winner=ranked.find(p=>!p.bankrupt)||ranked[0];
    document.getElementById('winner-emoji').textContent=winner?.avatar||'🏆';
    document.getElementById('winner-text').textContent=winner?`🏆 ${winner.name} 获胜！`:'平局！';
    document.getElementById('result-table').innerHTML=ranked.map((p,i)=>`
        <div class="result-row">
            <span>${i===0?'🥇':i===1?'🥈':i===2?'🥉':'#'+(i+1)}</span>
            <span>${p.name}${p.isHuman?' 👑':''}</span>
            <span>💰¥${p.money.toLocaleString()}</span>
            <span>总¥${getTotalAssets(p).toLocaleString()}</span>
        </div>
    `).join('');
    document.getElementById('result-modal').classList.add('active');
    log(`🏆 游戏结束！${winner?.name}获胜！`,'imp');
}

// ==================== Enter发送 ====================
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', ()=>{
    initSetup();
    const input=document.getElementById('chat-input');
    input.addEventListener('keypress',e=>{
        if(e.key==='Enter'){e.preventDefault();sendChat();}
    });
    // 输入框 focus 时，滚动到聊天区，但不影响其他布局
    input.addEventListener('focus',()=>{
        setTimeout(()=>{
            input.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'nearest'});
        },300);
    });
});
</script>
</body>
</html>
